blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines- A 25-year-old motorcyclist died after his bike crashed into a parked truck along the road in Barangay Colase, Samboan town, around 3:15 a.m. on Thursday, October 1. Authorities identified the victim as Junel James Trapa, a resident of Barangay Canlumacad, Santander town, the next town south. According to the Samboan Municipal Police Station, they received a call from a concerned citizen about the accident. They immediately responded, and upon their arrival, found out that the victim had already been brought to Oslob District Hospital for medical treatment.
